details: Producer Price Index (PPI) in the US surged to 6% year-over-year, leading to a crypto market sell-off where Bitcoin fell below $79,000 and triggered $400 million in liquidations.
title: US Inflation Fuels Crypto Market Sell-Off and Liquidations

details: The IMF warned that while tokenization can reduce friction, its speed and automation introduce new risks that could amplify financial crises and limit the time for regulatory intervention.
title: IMF Warns Tokenized Finance Could Amplify Market Crises

details: The NYSE is developing a blockchain-powered platform for 24/7 trading of tokenized stocks and ETFs, aiming for instant settlement and fractional ownership similar to the crypto market model.
title: NYSE Plans 24/7 Trading for Tokenized Stocks and ETFs

details: The US Congress is moving toward a permanent ban on a Federal Reserve-issued CBDC, a move viewed as positive for private stablecoin issuers by eliminating a government-backed competitor.
title: US Congress Nears Permanent Ban on Fed CBDC, Benefiting Stablecoins

details: The European Central Bank is increasing regulatory pressure on dollar-denominated stablecoins as part of its strategy to promote the digital euro and reduce reliance on dollar-pegged assets.
title: ECB Intensifies Pressure on Stablecoins Amid Digital Euro Push
